verdict.rationale: An agent can monitor payments through payment lifecycle webhooks, which can be managed via API, resent, or routed to EventBridge. It can also query payment statuses through the hosted MCP server. It can re-request payments against /payments using idempotency keys and create payment links that could be sent as recovery links. Retry logic and dunning outreach would have to be built by the agent, because the documented idempotent retries cover disrupted API calls, not declined-payment recovery. Missing for 10: native failed-payment retry/smart-retry scheduling, built-in dunning workflows or customer outreach, explicit failed/declined payment event documentation, and independent corroboration.
